title: text should be improved
body:
One of the first term that our users will meet is "hw data source".
"hw data source" is a very exact term for the developer writing the code, but has nothing to do with the parent who has just installed the software.

I guess we should rename it. Maybe something like "sensor type", or "sensor device".
I guess it is not simple, since the G5 needs nothing extra while libre can be used with multiple devices.
So, all ideas are welcomed.

And while touching this area, the "librealarm" should be extended to "librealarm/manual scan" or something similar.

All ideas are welcomed here, but we should probably make this something like the user would like to see it (and not the developer).
Once there is a consensus I'll do the change in code.
